tools.name: sarvam_tools_set_api_key
tools.description:
Set or update your Sarvam API key. Call this if you get an
authentication error or to configure your key for the first time.

If called without a key, returns instructions on where to get one.
If called with a key, saves it globally so you never need to set it again.

api_key.description: Your Sarvam API key (starts with sk_). Leave empty to get instructions on where to find it.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_upgrade
tools.description:
Check for updates and upgrade sarvam-mcp to the latest version.

Call this when the user asks to update, upgrade, or check for newer
versions of the sarvam MCP server.

Set ``confirm_upgrade=True`` to actually perform the upgrade.
After upgrading, restart the MCP server for changes to take effect.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_stt_transcribe
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Transcribe an audio file in any of 23 Indian languages using Saaras v4.

Saaras v4 (like v3) supports multiple output modes via the `mode` parameter:
  • `transcribe` (default) — standard transcription in the original language
  • `translate` — speech from any Indic language directly to English text
  • `verbatim` — exact word-for-word, no normalization, filler words preserved
  • `translit` — romanization to Latin/Roman script
  • `codemix` — English words in English, Indic words in native script

The default `language_code='unknown'` auto-detects, but specifying the language (e.g. `hi-IN`, `ta-IN`) gives better accuracy.
Speech-to-English uses this tool with `mode='translate'`.
For very long files (>30s), prefer `sarvam_stt_batch_submit`.

audio_path.description: Local path to the audio file.

audio_url.description: URL to fetch the audio file from.

filename.description: Filename with extension, e.g. 'recording.wav'. Required for base64/URL inputs.

language_code.description: BCP-47 code, e.g. 'hi-IN'. Use 'unknown' to auto-detect.

mode.description: Output mode (Saaras v3/v4 only). 'transcribe' (default) | 'translate' (→ English) | 'verbatim' | 'translit' (→ Roman) | 'codemix'.

with_timestamps.description: Include word-level timestamps in the response.

model.description: Saaras v4 (recommended, latest STT model for Indic audio). Falls back to saaras:v3 if needed.

input_audio_codec.description: Required only for PCM files. One of 'pcm_s16le', 'pcm_l16', 'pcm_raw'. PCM files are supported only at 16kHz sample rate.

keyterms.description: saaras:v4 only. Up to 50 domain-specific terms (max 64 chars each) to bias recognition toward — names, jargon, brand terms. Ignored by saaras:v3.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_stt_batch_submit
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Transcribe a long audio file (>30 s) using the batch job pipeline. Runs the full flow automatically: create job → upload audio to Azure Blob → start processing → poll until complete → return transcript.

Supports diarization, timestamps, all Saaras v4/v3 output modes, v4-only keyterms, and an optional webhook callback instead of polling.

audio_path.description: Local path to the audio file.

audio_url.description: URL to fetch the audio file from.

language_code.description: BCP-47 code, e.g. 'hi-IN'. Use 'unknown' to auto-detect.

num_speakers.description: Hint for diarization: expected number of speakers.

input_audio_codec.description: Required only for PCM files. One of 'pcm_s16le', 'pcm_l16', 'pcm_raw'. PCM files are supported only at 16kHz sample rate.

keyterms.description: saaras:v4 only. Up to 50 domain-specific terms (max 64 chars each) to bias recognition toward. Ignored by saaras:v3.

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL to notify on job completion, instead of polling. Requires callback_auth_token too.

callback_auth_token.description: Bearer token Sarvam will send with the callback_url webhook call.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_stt_batch_status
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

Poll the status of a batch transcription job. Returns the transcript once `job_state == 'Completed'`.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_stt_batch_download
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

Get fresh presigned download URLs for specific output files of a completed batch STT job. Use this if the URLs from sarvam_tools_stt_batch_status have expired. Requires the exact output filenames (e.g. '0.json') — get these from a prior sarvam_tools_stt_batch_status call's `output_files`.

files.description: Exact output filenames to fetch fresh URLs for, e.g. ['0.json']. Get these from sarvam_tools_stt_batch_status's `output_files`.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_stt_realtime
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Transcribe a mono 16-bit WAV (8000 or 16000 Hz) over GET /speech-to-text-realtime/ws. Use this when you need the realtime protocol (partials, VAD). Compressed audio and long recordings belong on sarvam_tools_stt_transcribe or sarvam_tools_stt_batch_submit.

Default model is saaras:v3-realtime. saaras:v4 adds keyterms. `language_code='unknown'` is sent as `auto`.

audio_path.description: Absolute path to a mono 16-bit PCM WAV at 8 kHz or 16 kHz.

stream_type.description: 'simulated' returns finals only. 'fast' or 'balanced' also emit partials.

keyterms.description: Saaras v4 only. Up to 50 terms.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_tts_speak
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Generate speech from text with bulbul:v3 (default) or bulbul:v4-flash. 11 Indic languages.

Speakers are model-specific:
  • bulbul:v3 — short names, default `shubh`. `priya` / `neha` / `pooja` (warm female), `aditya` / `rahul` / `kabir` (professional male), `shreya` / `kavya` / `ritu` (calm female), `vijay` / `gokul` / `anand` (mature male), `tanya` / `suhani` (young female).
  • bulbul:v4-flash — persona IDs `<voice>_<lang>_<style>`, default `shubh_enhi_ads`, e.g. `simran_en_customer`, `aparna_hi_customer`, `ritu_hi_customer`. 222 voice IDs (Assamese voices are not included — contact Sarvam for access); use sarvam_code_speakers('bulbul:v4-flash') for the full list. Native-script text works best (romanised Indic degrades quality).

The audio file is written under SARVAM_MCP_BASE_PATH (default ~/Desktop).

text.description: The text to synthesize. Max 2500 characters.

target_language_code.description: Output language. TTS supports 11 Indic languages.

speaker.description: Voice. Defaults to `shubh` (bulbul:v3) or `shubh_enhi_ads` (bulbul:v4-flash). Must match the model — see sarvam_code_speakers.

speech_sample_rate.description: PCM sample rate of the output WAV.

pitch.description: Pitch shift, -0.5 to 0.5. Omit for the voice's natural pitch.

loudness.description: Output gain, 0.1 to 2.5. Omit for default loudness.

dict_id.description: ID of a pronunciation dictionary (from sarvam_tools_pronunciation_create) to apply during synthesis, for custom word pronunciations.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_tts_stream
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Streaming variant of sarvam_tts_speak using the TTS WebSocket. Opens a connection, sends the text once, and collects the streamed audio chunks into a single WAV file (there's no reliable server-side 'done' signal, so completion is detected via a short idle timeout — expect a few extra seconds of latency vs. sarvam_tts_speak for that reason). Falls back to the REST endpoint if the WebSocket is unavailable.

speaker.description: Voice; defaults per model (`shubh` / `shubh_enhi_ads`). Must match the model.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_translate
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Translate text between English and Indian languages.

Two backing models:
- `mayura:v1` — 11 languages, supports formal / colloquial / code-mixed modes, script + numeral controls. Best for short, stylized translations.
- `sarvam-translate:v1` — all 22 scheduled languages + English, formal only. Best when you need broad coverage.

input.description: Text to translate. Max length depends on model: 1000 chars for mayura:v1, 2000 chars for sarvam-translate:v1.

source_language_code.description: Source BCP-47 code, or 'auto' to auto-detect.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_transliterate
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Convert text between scripts without translating meaning. Examples: Devanagari → Roman ('नमस्ते' → 'namaste'), Tamil script → Latin, etc. Use `spoken_form=True` to expand digits and abbreviations into spoken form.

source_language_code.description: Source language code (e.g. 'hi-IN'), or 'auto' to auto-detect.

target_language_code.description: Target language code (script of the output).

spoken_form_numerals_language.description: Language to use when speaking out numbers (only with spoken_form=True).

tools.name: sarvam_tools_identify_language
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Detect the language and script of input text. Returns BCP-47 language code (e.g. 'hi-IN') and script code (e.g. 'Devanagari'). Useful as a pre-step before TTS or translate to pick the right language args automatically.

input.description: Text whose language to identify. Max 1000 characters.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_text_analytics
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

PERMANENTLY REMOVED: Sarvam retired the old analytics/parse API family (this `/text-analytics` endpoint included) — confirmed via a direct API call outside this tool (404, first observed 2026-08-13) and via Sarvam's own SDK release notes, which describe the removal as deliberate, not an outage. Calling this tool raises immediately instead of making a doomed network round trip. There is no direct 1:1 replacement for typed-question text analysis; for document/text extraction, check whether 'SarvamParse' (a new lightweight beta endpoint) fits your use case — see docs.sarvam.ai for current availability and request shape.

questions.description: List of question objects: [{'id': 'q1', 'text': 'When was X founded?', 'type': 'short answer'}, ...]. Required fields: id (str), text (str), type (one of 'boolean'|'enum'|'short answer'|'long answer'|'number'). For 'enum' questions, also include 'options': ['a', 'b', ...].

tools.name: sarvam_tools_llm_complete
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Generate chat completions with Sarvam's Indic-tuned LLM.

Two models on this endpoint:
- `sarvam-105b` (default) — 128K context, best for complex reasoning, coding, long-context analysis, agentic tool use.
- `sarvam-105b-conversations` — 32K context, post-trained for real-time dialogue and voice agents; more natural/colloquial Indic replies. Same price as sarvam-105b. Prefer this one for low-latency conversational loops (e.g. behind sarvam_tools_voice).

Supports 23 Indic languages with native, romanized, and code-mixed styles. OpenAI-compatible message format, including function calling (`tools`/`tool_choice`) and structured output (`response_format`).

model.description: `sarvam-105b` (flagship, 128K ctx) or `sarvam-105b-conversations` (32K ctx, tuned for voice/chat-agent workloads).

reasoning_effort.description: sarvam-105b reasons by default even if you don't ask for it, consuming a variable, often large chunk of max_tokens on hidden reasoning before any visible content is produced. 'low' reduces that overhead but does NOT eliminate it — a small max_tokens (e.g. 20-100) can still come back empty. If you set max_tokens, give it real headroom (300+); omitting max_tokens entirely is the safest way to always get visible content. Omit this field to use the API's own default effort.

stream.description: Streaming via MCP isn't useful for chat — keep False unless testing.

tools.description: OpenAI-style function-calling tool definitions.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_vision_digitise
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Digitise a document with Sarvam Vision (POST /doc-ai/v1/job/digitise). Full-document OCR that keeps layout, reading order, and tables. Output is markdown (`md`), HTML, or JSON.

Uploads the file, polls until a terminal status, and returns the download URL. Max 10 pages. Use `language` (not language_code). Pass `md`, not `markdown`.

document_path.description: Local path to a PDF, PNG, JPEG, or ZIP. Max 10 pages.

document_url.description: URL to fetch the document from.

filename.description: Filename with extension. Required for base64 or URL inputs.

language.description: BCP-47 language of the document, e.g. 'hi-IN'. Field name is language.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_vision_extract
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Schema extraction with Sarvam Vision (POST /doc-ai/v1/job/extract). Pass a JSON schema (root type object, every field needs type and description) or a saved `config_id`. Returns structured fields from GET /doc-ai/v1/job/{job_id}/results.

For full-document OCR to markdown or HTML, use sarvam_tools_vision_digitise.

document_path.description: Local path to a PDF, PNG, JPEG, or ZIP. Max 10 pages.

document_url.description: URL to fetch the document from.

filename.description: Filename with extension. Required for base64 or URL inputs.

schema.description: JSON schema object. Root must be type=object with properties. Each field needs type and a non-empty description. Provide this or config_id.

config_id.description: Saved extraction config. Provide this or schema.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_vision_job_status
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

Poll a Document AI job at GET /doc-ai/v1/job/{job_id}/status. Works for both digitise and extract. Terminal statuses: completed, partially_completed, failed, rejected.

job_id.description: Job id from vision_digitise or vision_extract.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_pronunciation_list
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

List all pronunciation dictionary IDs owned by the authenticated user. Returns dictionary_count and a list of dictionary IDs.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_pronunciation_get
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

Retrieve a specific pronunciation dictionary by its ID. Returns the dictionary entries (word → pronunciation mappings).

tools.name: sarvam_tools_pronunciation_create
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

Create a new pronunciation dictionary with word → pronunciation mappings. These dictionaries can be referenced in TTS calls to control how specific words are spoken.

Max 100 words per dictionary, 10 dictionaries per user.

language_code.description: BCP-47 language code for these entries, e.g. 'hi-IN', 'en-IN', 'ta-IN'.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_pronunciation_delete
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

Delete a pronunciation dictionary by its ID.

dictionary_id.description: The pronunciation dictionary ID to delete.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_document_translate
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Translate a whole document (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML) via POST /translate/document/jobs. Layout is preserved. Up to 12 target languages.

Creates the job, uploads the file to the signed URL, and starts it. Poll with sarvam_tools_document_translate_status. This is not sarvam_tools_translate (plain text) or sarvam_tools_localize (string tables).

document_path.description: Absolute path to the source document.

style_guidelines.description: Tone or terminology notes, up to about 4000 characters.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_document_translate_status
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

Poll GET /translate/document/jobs/{job_id}/live-status. job_state is Accepted, Running, Completed, PartiallyCompleted, or Failed.

Set export=true once a target language is Completed to enqueue POST .../export and return signed download URLs.

export.description: When true, export every language whose state is Completed and return download URLs.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_dubbing_submit
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Start an official dubbing job (POST /dubbing/jobs) for a video or audio file. Creates the job, uploads the media, and starts processing. Voice cloning is on by default. Up to 12 target languages.

Poll with sarvam_tools_dubbing_status. For a short clip that should come back as a single WAV, use sarvam_tools_dub instead.

media_path.description: Absolute path to the source video or audio.

target_langs.description: One or more target BCP-47 codes.

export_options.description: Formats to export: video, audio, mp3, srt.

voice_id.description: Preset voice when voice_cloning is false.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_dubbing_status
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now.

Poll a dubbing job. live-status reports pipeline progress. export-status returns signed download URLs per language and format (video, audio, mp3, srt). URLs last about 24 hours.

tools.name: sarvam_code_api_reference
tools.description:
Build-time tool — helps write code that uses Sarvam. For runtime actions, use sarvam_tools_* instead.

Return the authoritative request/response shape for a Sarvam API endpoint — parameters, defaults, content type, auth header, common gotchas. Faster + more accurate than free-text doc search when the agent already knows which endpoint to use.

tools.name: sarvam_code_languages
tools.description:
Build-time tool — helps write code that uses Sarvam. For runtime actions, use sarvam_tools_* instead.

List supported BCP-47 language codes for a given Sarvam API. Critical because coverage varies by API: STT supports 23 langs, TTS supports 11, etc. Returns code + display name + script.

api.description: Which Sarvam API. STT covers 23; TTS covers 11.

tools.name: sarvam_code_speakers
tools.description:
Build-time tool — helps write code that uses Sarvam. For runtime actions, use sarvam_tools_* instead.

List TTS speakers compatible with a given model tag. Speaker IDs are model-specific: bulbul:v3 has 37 short-name voices; bulbul:v4-flash has 222 persona IDs (`<voice>_<lang>_<style>`; Assamese voices are not included — contact Sarvam for access). Returns each speaker with a brief tone hint where available.

tools.name: sarvam_code_pricing
tools.description:
Build-time tool — helps write code that uses Sarvam. For runtime actions, use sarvam_tools_* instead.

Current pricing structure for a Sarvam model (or all models if omitted). Returns billing unit + rate tier. NOTE: this is a high-level structure; exact per-unit rates depend on your plan — always confirm at https://dashboard.sarvam.ai before quoting.

model.description: Specific model id, e.g. 'bulbul:v3' or 'bulbul:v4-flash'. Omit to list all.

tools.name: sarvam_code_snippet
tools.description:
Build-time tool — helps write code that uses Sarvam. For runtime actions, use sarvam_tools_* instead.

Return a tested, copy-paste-ready code snippet for calling a Sarvam API. The agent should use this as the starting point when adding Sarvam to an existing codebase. Snippets are verified live against api.sarvam.ai with current model versions; they assume `SARVAM_API_KEY` is set in the env.

tools.name: sarvam_code_recommend_model
tools.description:
Build-time tool — helps write code that uses Sarvam. For runtime actions, use sarvam_tools_* instead.

Given a plain-English description of what the dev wants to build, recommend the right Sarvam model + language code + any other key params. Useful as the first step when starting a new Sarvam-using app. Uses heuristics (no LLM call), so it's fast and works without an API key.

task_description.description: What the dev wants to build, e.g. 'transcribe Hindi voicemails'.

tools.name: sarvam_code_validate_request
tools.description:
Build-time tool — helps write code that uses Sarvam. For runtime actions, use sarvam_tools_* instead.

Validate a draft Sarvam API request body against the canonical schema BEFORE the dev sends it. Catches: invalid model names, speaker/model mismatches, deprecated values, unsupported language codes, missing required fields. Returns a list of issues with fix suggestions.

body.description: The draft request body the agent is about to send.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_voice
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

End-to-end voice agent loop: transcribe an Indic audio file, send the transcript to the Indic-tuned LLM for a reply, then synthesize the reply to audio.

Returns: transcript, reply text, output audio file path. Default reply language follows the detected input language; set `reply_language` to force a specific output.

audio_path.description: Local path to the input audio file.

audio_url.description: URL to fetch the audio file from.

system_prompt.default: You are a concise, helpful assistant fluent in Indic languages. Reply in the user's input language unless asked otherwise.
system_prompt.description: System message guiding the LLM reply.

reply_language.description: Force the TTS output language. Defaults to the detected input language (or hi-IN if detection fails).

speaker.description: TTS voice. Defaults to the model's default (`shubh` for bulbul:v3, `shubh_enhi_ads` for bulbul:v4-flash). Speaker IDs are model-specific — see sarvam_code_speakers.

llm_model.description: `sarvam-105b-conversations` (default, 32K ctx) — post-trained for real-time dialogue/voice agents, which is what this workflow is. Switch to `sarvam-105b` (128K ctx) only if a reply needs deep reasoning, coding, or a long context window.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_dub
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Dub a short Indic audio clip into another Indic language. Pipeline: STT → Mayura or Sarvam-Translate → TTS. Returns the original transcript, translated transcript, and a path to the newly-dubbed WAV file. For video or long media, use sarvam_tools_dubbing_submit.

target_language_code.description: Output language for the dubbed audio.

audio_path.description: Local path to the source audio file.

audio_url.description: URL to fetch the audio file from.

speaker.description: TTS voice. Defaults to the model's default (`shubh` for bulbul:v3, `shubh_enhi_ads` for bulbul:v4-flash). Speaker IDs are model-specific — see sarvam_code_speakers.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_localize
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Translate a JSON or `key=value` string-table file into another language. Walks all string values (nested JSON supported), runs each through Sarvam-Translate, and writes a sibling file with the language code as suffix (e.g. `messages.en.json` → `messages.hi.json`).

For repos with many files, call this tool once per locale file. Skips non-string leaves (numbers, booleans, etc.) untouched.

source_path.description: Absolute path to a JSON file or `key=value` text file.

output_path.description: Where to write the localized file. Defaults to the source path with the target language code injected before the extension.

max_strings.description: Hard cap on values translated per call.

tools.name: sarvam_tools_recall
tools.description:
Runtime tool — calls Sarvam API now. For code-writing help, use sarvam_code_* tools.

Answer a natural-language question grounded in a set of files. Audio files are transcribed; text/markdown files are read directly. Everything is concatenated (capped at 24000 chars) and passed to the LLM with a grounded-QA system prompt. Useful for quickly querying meeting recordings, Indic-language notes, or mixed-format research folders.

paths.description: Absolute paths to files (audio or text) and/or directories. Directories are walked recursively.

stt_language.description: STT hint applied to every audio file.

llm_model.description: `sarvam-105b` (default, 128K ctx) — best for summarizing a large corpus. `sarvam-105b-conversations` (32K ctx) is tuned for voice/chat-agent replies instead, not grounded summarization.
